title: Degrees of Maps between Generalized Dold Manifolds
summary: We study the existence of maps of nonzero Brouwer degree between two orientable, equal-dimensional generalized Dold manifolds (GDMs) fibered by complex partial flag manifolds over real projective spaces. The GDMs considered here are obtained as orbit spaces of the diagonal involution on the product of a sphere and a complex partial flag manifold, acting antipodally on the sphere and by complex conjugation on the flag manifold. We show that no map of nonzero degree exists between two distinct GDMs when their base real projective spaces are different, except in one exceptional case.…
